doc: The restricted handwritten-TypeScript subset (kemiller2002/limen#54), checked by scripts/check-typescript.ts in npm test. Guardrail-owned. `sanctioned` names the one place a rule is deliberately not applied, with the reason; `knownDebt` is a ratchet — the exact count of pre-existing findings tied to the work item that removes them. A new finding fails; a count that drops fails until the entry is reduced, so debt can only shrink.

sanctioned.reason: The generic capability seam: Core carries an opaque request it must not interpret. defineCapability is the only way a provider receives it, and it decodes with the pack's generated decoder or answers Rejected. Every other file is checked.

The conformance suite feeds providers raw wire input on purpose — malformed payloads are what it tests — so its fixtures are typed `unknown`, the honest type of untrusted wire data. It dispatches nothing itself.

knownDebt.reason: The federation envelope protocol is still defined only in TypeScript (src/federation.ts), so no generated decoder exists for manifests, dispatch results, snapshots or envelopes. WI-0030 brings it under the neutral contract and removes these.
The .NET runtime module is typed by assertion; removed with the federation transport's decoders in WI-0030.
invokeEnvelope(operation: string) calls a .NET export by name; the federation operations become a closed generated union in WI-0030.
